questions.key_step: Homogenise the circle with the tangent; perpendicular pair means coefficients of x^2 and y^2 sum to zero.
questions.justification: Single standard move (pair of lines from the origin) followed by short algebra; no case work. Comparable to 2021-P2-Q8 (L2).

questions.key_step: Substitute Q(2theta) in the normal; quadratic in cos(theta); reject 7/6.
questions.justification: One standard substitution and a quadratic; the only care is rejecting 7/6. Same demand as 2021-P2-Q8 (L2).

questions.key_step: Sum of distances PS1+PS2=r1+r2 is constant, so locus is an ellipse with foci the centres.
questions.justification: One recognition (contact conditions give a constant focal sum) then two readings off the ellipse; no casework. Routine chain, numerical p+q.

questions.key_step: Sine rule in triangle PST (cos theta = sin alpha / sin beta), then eliminate theta via tangent slope.
questions.justification: Two stages (sine rule on a focal triangle, then slope elimination) with trigonometric bookkeeping and a proof format; one non-obvious setup. Slightly above routine chains.

questions.key_step: Slope of tangent at t is 1/t so cot(theta)=t; area of tangent triangle depends on parameter differences.
questions.justification: Needs the tangent-triangle area formula (not a basic recall for many students) and the reading cot(theta)=t; computation is short. Same kind of demand as 2024-P2-Q7 (L4) but simpler.

questions.key_step: Abscissa 4a gives t=2; second parameter of normal chord is -3; compare lengths.
questions.justification: Standard parameter machinery with two lengths to compare; no insight needed. Same chain as 2021-P2-Q8 (L2).

questions.key_step: PQ=2|t1-t2| and h=2t1t2, k=2(t1+t2): eliminate.
questions.justification: Parameter elimination with one given length; straightforward. Equivalent difficulty to 2021-P2-Q8 (L2).

questions.key_step: Perpendicular tangents give m1=-m; two quadratics in m with common root; eliminate m.
questions.justification: Two tangent families linked by perpendicularity and an elimination with cross-multiplication; algebra is long but the route is standard. Between 2026-P2-Q2 (L3) and a plain locus (L2).

questions.key_step: CS perpendicular to AB makes t3 a root of a cubic with u=sum t; Vieta by symmetry.
questions.justification: The key idea (each parameter is a root of the same cubic, so Vieta gives the symmetric sums) is non-routine, though the algebra is short; numerical answer with no options to check. Similar flavour to 2024-P2-Q7 (L4).

questions.key_step: Chord touches y^2=2x gives 16 t1 t2=(t1+t2)^2; express through h,k.
questions.justification: Parameter chord plus a tangency condition, then elimination; two stages with moderate algebra and a numerical answer. Comparable to 2026-P2-Q2 (L3).

questions.key_step: Normal at P(t) through Q(t1) gives t^2+t1 t+2=0; discriminant > 0.
questions.justification: One standard relation and a discriminant; very short proof. Comparable to 2021-P2-Q8 (L2).

questions.key_step: P is the midpoint of CQ; C = (a(2+t^2),0).
questions.justification: Straight application of the normal equation and the midpoint condition; two linear equations in the parameter. Equivalent to 2021-P2-Q8 (L2).

questions.key_step: t1t2=-c/a for chord through (c,0); multiply relations to eliminate t2,t3.
questions.justification: Idea is one tidy relation then algebra; proof format with symbolic fixed points (c,d,e). Non-routine but short; same flavour as 2021-P2-Q6 (L4 MCQ) though simpler.

questions.key_step: Normals meeting on the curve imply t1t2=2; then t1+t2 from the y-coordinate.
questions.justification: Several standard normal formulas chained, then a numerical product; precision matters (signs of the points) with no options. Same as 2023-P1-Q7 (L3) in demand.

questions.key_step: Congruent touching parabolas: vertices symmetric about the point of contact (or discriminant zero).
questions.justification: One standard setup (equal parabolas, opposite opening) and a discriminant; the symmetry view is the elegant shortcut. Routine L3 on 'two ideas linked' scale.

questions.key_step: Normal chord t1^2+t1t2=-2; circle through vertex gives cubic; eliminate t1,t2.
questions.justification: Long elimination with a hidden symmetry (cubic with zero sum); numerically heavy symbolic work with a proof format. Similar to 2023-P1-Q7 (L3) but with more algebra.

questions.key_step: Perpendiculars from the focus to the tangents meet at the focus; L passes through the focus.
questions.justification: Finding the focus from three tangents needs the foot-of-perpendicular property (an idea outside the most routine pattern), followed by three short answers. Similar to 2021-P2-Q6 (L4) in idea but simpler.

questions.key_step: Normals meeting on curve (t1t2=2); right angles at P and Q make TR a diameter.
questions.justification: Three linked parts: constraint t1t2=2, the fixed point, then a circumcentre via concyclicity (a non-obvious step); long careful algebra where the printed key and working go astray in part (c). Higher end of chapter-sheet questions.

questions.key_step: Equal touching parabolas open oppositely; equate slopes to get contact x=3.
questions.justification: Parameter a is found from tangency, then a three-curve region area with an irrational limit; two ideas linked and computation-heavy. Comparable to 2023-P1-Q7 (L3).

questions.key_step: Normal chord condition t1^2+t1t2=-2; express h,k in terms of t1.
questions.justification: Parametric elimination with a shifted parabola; one standard chain and a final shift back. Comparable to 2026-P2-Q2 (L3) on this scale.

questions.key_step: Normal slope cubic m^3+(2-h)m+k=0 with m1m2=alpha; substitute m3=-k/alpha.
questions.justification: Needs the slope-form cubic, then a substitution and coefficient matching; precision matters but the route is a standard trick. Same demand as 2023-P1-Q7 (L3).

questions.key_step: P is the midpoint of GQ with G=(a e^2 cos theta,0); Q is an axis-scaled image of P.
questions.justification: Normal equation, midpoint relation and an eccentricity computation; routine algebra with no insight required. Same as 2021-P2-Q8 (L2).
